title: Review queue spike
summary: Simulate a sudden increase in pull requests while review capacity is constrained.

trigger.description: Several reviewers become unavailable during a release window.

assumptions: Recent review activity is a proxy for queue capacity, not an individual performance score.
A queue can be triaged without merging unreviewed changes.

inputs.name: reviewers
inputs.description: Reviewed backup reviewers for protected paths.

score.formula: 100 minus bounded penalties for protected paths without a backup reviewer

recovery_actions: Document a review rotation and escalation window.
Practice pausing risky merges while preserving urgent fixes.
limitations: Does not read private review permissions or predict human availability.
Does not approve, merge, or close pull requests.
